The '''Sha-Thes Meadow''' was an uncorrupted plain located south of the [[Nightmare Lands]] proper on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The [[Voss commandos]] maintained [[Shad-Ka Outpost]] in the meadow, and the [[Defiled Brook]] ran through it.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sha-Thes Meadow appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
